$comment: Single source of tuning constants (D-100). Integers only (D-098): bp = basis points (10000 = 1.0), pm = per-mille, Para = display money unit (1 Birim = 1000 Para). Points = 0..100 stat scale (engine stores 100 bp per point).

dayBudget.$comment: D-061 bands; shown days per year incl. the birthday card; cap = band max + capAboveMax

surprise.$comment: Sprint 3: a day picked from the surprise pool (card.surpriseTier) resets pity and counts as a surprise, tagged or not (the counter used to see only the 9 tagged events, so pity never reset and sessionCap never bound).

momCall.$comment: D-108: ≤ 3 per life; cooldown in shown days

momReversion.$comment: Sprint 3: Anne Baskısı mean-reverts toward restBp (yearPm per year of the distance) while mom lives; birthday pulses (bp) add life-stage pressure.

cringeReversion.$comment: Sprint 3: Cringe mean-reverts toward restBp (yearPm per year of the distance) instead of decaying to 0; a birthday pulse adds egoPm x (ego - 50) when ego is high.

joyHedonic.$comment: Sprint 3 hedonic adaptation: positive joy outcomes are scaled by highPm above highBp and topPm above topBp; drift pulls joy above midBp back by yearPm per year of the excess.

rentCard.$comment: D-159: the rent-crisis card is shown at most once per minGapDays; other shortfalls only accrue debt (gap line). Sprint 3: only for a landlord's home (kinds); owned / mortgage / mom's house never get the landlord card.

careerLadder.$comment: D-159 birthday raise roll (tier+1 up to maxTier) after minYearsByTier[tier] years in the tier (sprint 3: slower at the top so mid-career still moves). Never for a retiree. ranks[tier] = title-ladder key the app prefixes to the job title (jobRank()).

bailout.$comment: 02 §2.3.6: offered as a day card (priority 7) from the rent-day event (effects.bailoutCheck) or the birthday pulse; amounts live in the events

protection.$comment: Sprint 3 (P1-4): the 18-28 window halves only negative HEALTH outcomes; money effects apply exactly as written (no '600 ödedin -> -300').

flowKind.$comment: Denge sprinti 3 (P0-1): the 5th-of-month housing payment is a 'rent' flow line only for rented homes. owned / inherited -> 'upkeep' (aidat + bills), mortgage -> 'mortgage' (installment), momsHouse after mom's death -> 'upkeep'. The rent-crisis card (and pre.rentShortfall) only counts shortfalls on rentCard.kinds.

lifestyle.$comment: Sprint 3 lifestyle creep (02 §2.3.3): share of income spent per month, by job tier (index = tier), plus a pattern offset; snapshotted each birthday.

comfortSpend.$comment: Sprint 3 money sink: savings above freeMonths x monthly income (floor floorMonthlyPara) are spent at yearPm per year (cars, holidays, helping family) - folded into the daily line.

child.$comment: Sprint 3: a living child costs max(minPara, income x pm) per month until untilAge (folded into the daily line, GapLine.child).

mortgage.$comment: Sprint 3: a mortgage is paid off after termYears (birthday check) and the home becomes 'owned'.

retirement.$comment: Sprint 3 (P1-3): from minAge each birthday rolls chanceBp to retire (certain at maxAge). Pension = pm x last salary (full after fullYears worked). A retiree gets no raises / rung changes, the 'emekli' flag, no boss, and a 'pension' flow line instead of 'payday'.

causeState.$comment: Playtest 2026-11-12: cause follows state. Per-mille multipliers on the age-band weights. Rows [maxHealthPoints, illnessPm, suddenPm] (illness = circ/tumor/resp, sudden = accident/external); absurd stays as is.

omen.$comment: Son perde: an illness death rolled on a birthday (sprint 3: always, any health/age) is deferred by deathDelayDays and foreshadowed by 1..maxCards 'omen' events (forced, priority 6). No omen event eligible -> immediate death (old behaviour).

npcLife.$comment: NPC aging (playtest 2026-11-12: cat lived 65 years, mom ~100). Each birthday every living NPC in `roles` rolls its yearly death chance (bp) from `hazardBpByAge` [[maxNpcAge, bp]] on the hazard channel (after the player's die). ageAtStart = NPC age on the player's 18th birthday. On a hit one eligible 'loss:<role>' event is queued (priority 6) and the NPC dies when that card is shown (or when the item is dropped). No loss event in the bundle -> no roll.

impliedByTag.$comment: Implicit NPC gate by tag (like the D-062 speaker gate): an event carrying one of these tags needs the role alive, unless its pre names that role under npc or it carries a grief tag.

npcLife.$griefComment: Sprint 3 (O3): a forced followUp queued by a grief-tagged event waits at least griefShownDays shown days (the inheritance decision no longer lands the day after the death).

flagsByTag.$comment: Sprint 3 implicit flag gate: an event carrying the tag needs at least one of the flags (unless its pre names one of them).

textGates.$comment: Sprint 3: events whose text names the player's cat (TR Pamuk / EN Biscuit) are gated like a 'kedi' tag (cat alive); in-law words need a marriage flag. Grief-tagged events are exempt. Skip lines naming a cat need the cat alive.

child.$comment: Minimal child-age gate (content schema has no childAge leaf). Child age = (calendarDay - npc.bornDay)/365. Tag rows [tag, minYears, maxYears] (-1 = open); untagged child events need childAge >= pre.age.min - assumedParentAge. Legacy children without bornDay are not gated.

absolute.$comment: Playtest 2026-11-12: the yearly-delta grade is capped/floored by the absolute level. caps [[belowPoints, maxGrade]] (first match wins, lowest threshold first), floors [[atLeastPoints, minGrade]] (highest first). Grades: 4 A · 3 B · 2 C · 1 D · 0 F. Money in Para.

health.$comment: Sprint 3: health < 30 is always Zayıf (F), < 45 at most Geçer, < 55 at most Orta.

ritual.$comment: Yearly ritual variants (playtest: the birthday line / Yılın Mottosu / 'Zarf yok' repeated verbatim 46x). The engine picks an index on the cosmetic channel, never one used in the last noRepeatYears picks; the app owns the text (apps/mobile i18n). Pool sizes must match the app catalog.

milestones.$comment: D-157 Hayat Yolu: on each birthday, a stage whose conditions hold rolls chanceBp; on success one eligible 'milestone:<id>' event is queued (priority 6, in dueMin..dueMax days). Sprint 3: needPartner null = either; minMoney (Para) and housingNone gate a stage too. Stage 'ev' (buy a home) fires 'milestone:ev' events (content to tag).
